'''2006 World Championship 6 V-Card Tournament David Destefanis DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (6 V-Card Tournament); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2006-11-04).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35783 David Destefani's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Senate]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225524/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35783 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David Destefanis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2006 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' 6 V-Card Tournament

== Original post ==

'''David Destefani's 6 V-Card Deck - DS Senate'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' November 4, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4
* '''Description:''' David Detefani's DS Senate Deck that he used for the 6 V-Card Tournament

=== Strategy ===

This deck went 0-3 in the 6 V-Card Qualifer tournament. It lost to Evan Fitzgerald, Brant Wood and Scott Church.
